spec_match.rationale: Polls the real getStats() promise once a second and renders the exact dictionary members the spec and ChromeStatus name for Chromium (RTT trio, nullable estimatedSendRate, atSendCapacity); nothing is derived from anywhere but a resolved stats object.

interactive.rationale: Editable endpoint URL with datalist alternates, keepalive-datagram toggle, connect with connecting/ready/failed states, disconnect that also abandons an in-flight attempt, live table and SVG sparkline.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the 1 Hz table, sparkline, mid-flight disconnect, and honest failure surfacing; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-WebTransport, method-missing, constructor-throw (bad URL), 15s connect timeout, mid-session failure stopping the poll loop with the spec's InvalidStateError explanation, null estimatedSendRate, and absent members rendered as 'not returned'.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5120203192139776, the ConnectionStats dictionary anchor, and the MSEdge demo.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite covers the surface and failure contracts this page relies on; verified executing 6/6 behind WebTransportStats on Chromium 153 and honestly 0/6 unflagged.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright-driven CDP; chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable here) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, unflagged and behind WebTransportStats. Flagged connect attempts to echo.webtransport.day and the dead local endpoint both land in the labelled failed state ('WebTransportError — Opening handshake failed.') with retry available and zero page errors — this container's proxy cannot tunnel UDP/QUIC, so the established/polling branch (live table values, moving sparkline) could not run here and remains unverified.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts established, snapshot-shape per tick, connect-failure-surfaced, and the two fallback branches; console output is intentional and prefixed [wt-stats:monitor].

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; state chip colours (emerald-dark/rose) on near-white; buttons overriding background set color; table wrapped in overflow-x container.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled url/checkbox controls, state line is aria-live=polite, sparkline SVG carries role=img with a title plus a text equivalent line that restates latest/max values, table has caption and th scope.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports screenshotted and overflow-checked; controls grid collapses via auto-fit minmax; 44px tap targets.

openQuestions.title: Verify the established polling loop against a reachable HTTP/3 endpoint
openQuestions.detail: Every failure branch is browser-verified, but no network in this container can complete a WebTransport handshake, so the ready branch — ticking table values, sparkline growth, keepalive datagrams feeding estimatedSendRate, clean disconnect mid-poll — needs one verification run from an unproxied network on Chrome 159 or Chromium 153+ with --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats against echo.webtransport.day:4433 or the MSEdge akaleapi endpoints.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep header semantics (caption, th scope) and let wide tables scroll inside their own wrapper rather than the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Snapshot table uses caption + scoped headers inside .table-wrap with overflow-x:auto; verified no page-level horizontal overflow at 360px DPR3.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates live region after button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce connection state changes through a polite live region; avoid announcing every ticking value.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The state chip is aria-live=polite and changes only on state transitions; per-second table values deliberately do not announce, with the sparkline text equivalent summarising latest/max instead.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider input accessible labeling and keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native labelled controls with adequate touch targets and visible constraint hints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: URL input and checkbox are native elements with <label for>, min-height 44px, and hints describing the endpoint requirement.

summary: The 1 Hz troubleshooting loop the feature exists for, with every failure branch (constructor throw, timeout, handshake failure, mid-session death) verified honest on headless Chromium 153; the established branch is labelled as requiring a reachable HTTP/3 endpoint rather than simulated.
